children: Overview
Canada financial holding company reported Q3 adjusted net earnings rose yr/yr
Q3 net earnings increased to $1,006 mln from $703 mln a year ago
Adjusted net asset value per share rose 32% from end-2025, driven by public holdings
Outlook
Company did not provide specific guidance for the current quarter or full year
Result Drivers
PUBLIC COMPANY PERFORMANCE - Growth in adjusted net asset value per share was primarily driven by publicly traded operating companies, notably Great-West Lifeco and IGM Financial

RETIREMENT AND WEALTH MOMENTUM - Great-West's adjusted net earnings increased due to continued momentum in Retirement and Wealth businesses and robust Capital Solutions new business growth, partially offset by unfavorable insurance experience in Canada

ASSET MANAGEMENT GROWTH - IGM Financial's results benefited from a step acquisition gain and strong operating performance in wealth and asset management, with record assets under management and advisement
